intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} programmes in {{cityA}}, and both are listed with GATE. This page compares official IIT Madras fees we opened in {{year}}, the recorded rows in our table, and the NIRF ranks we hold.
IIT Madras vs SRM Institute of Science and Technology is not a close ranking fight. IIT Madras holds a NIRF 2025 Engineering rank of 1 on our records. SRM is listed at 14 in the same year.

sections.heading: IIT Madras vs SRM IST for M.Tech / M.E.: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose IIT Madras if you want a public IIT M.Tech through GATE, with a NIRF 2025 Engineering rank of 1, and you will budget from the official 2026–27 postgraduate fee circular rather than from our older itemised heads.

Choose SRM IST only if a private-university M.Tech is the seat you actually have, after you confirm the official fee, because our recorded tuition of ₹16,000 a year looks incomplete next to a typical private M.Tech notice.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: Our IIT Madras rows still show older itemised heads, including ₹10,000 tuition and small exam or registration amounts. Do not quote those small heads as the M.Tech fee.

The official IIT Madras 2026–27 postgraduate circular lists M.Tech tuition of ₹25,000 a semester for Indian students, with a first payment of ₹66,402 for general, OBC and EWS students, including one-time fees, semester fees and a refundable deposit.
SC, ST and PwD students have a lower first payment because tuition is waived. Recheck the official circular if your category or hostel arrangement differs.

For SRM IST we hold ₹16,000 tuition and ₹10,000 registration as year figures on several M.Tech rows. That recorded tuition looks low, so confirm the official SRM notice before you budget. We have not invented a higher official total.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: IIT Madras's only M.Tech placement row here is from 2017, with ₹5 lakh average and ₹50 lakh highest for aerospace engineering. That year is too old to treat as a current flagship figure.
SRM IST has a 2023 M.Tech Big Data Analytics row of ₹8 lakh average and ₹52 lakh highest. That is a historical record for that stream, not a promise for every M.Tech branch.
Ask both placement cells for a later official M.Tech report. Do not stretch the 2017 IIT Madras row into a 2026 comparison.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: Both are listed with GATE. IIT Madras M.Tech admissions follow the official GATE and COAP process. Confirm SRM's current GATE or institute route on its official page.
On our records, IIT Madras has NIRF Engineering ranks of 1 in 2025 and 2024. SRM IST has a NIRF 2025 Engineering rank of 14. Confirm the current list on nirfindia.org.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are recorded in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, so the city is the same. The campuses, research labs and student communities are not interchangeable.
IIT Madras is a public Institute of National Importance. SRM IST is a large private university. Visit the department you would join, and read the official offer letter for the fee and stipend rules.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick IIT Madras if a public IIT M.Tech and the NIRF 2025 Engineering rank of 1 are the goal, and you have the official 2026–27 fee circular in hand.
Pick SRM IST only if that is the seat you have been offered, after you confirm the official M.Tech fee rather than our ₹16,000 tuition row.
Do not decide from the 2017 IIT Madras package row, and do not treat small exam or registration heads as tuition.

faqs.question: What is the official IIT Madras M.Tech fee for 2026–27?
faqs.answer: The official postgraduate circular lists tuition of ₹25,000 a semester for Indian students, with a first payment of ₹66,402 for general, OBC and EWS students. SC, ST and PwD students have a lower first payment because tuition is waived.

faqs.question: What M.Tech fee is on record for SRM IST?
faqs.answer: We hold ₹16,000 tuition and ₹10,000 registration as year figures on several M.Tech rows. That recorded tuition looks incomplete, so confirm the official SRM notice before you budget.

faqs.question: Are recent M.Tech placements available for IIT Madras?
faqs.answer: Not on this page. The only IIT Madras M.Tech row here is from 2017. SRM IST has a 2023 big-data row of ₹8 lakh average and ₹52 lakh highest. Ask both campuses for a later official report.

faqs.question: Which college has the better NIRF Engineering rank?
faqs.answer: On our records, IIT Madras is ranked 1 in 2025 and 2024. SRM IST is ranked 14 in 2025. Confirm the official NIRF Engineering list if you need the exact listing.

faqs.question: Do both programmes use GATE?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are listed with GATE. IIT Madras follows the official GATE and COAP process. Confirm SRM's current route on its official page.

faqs.question: Are both campuses in Chennai?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are recorded in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, though IIT Madras is a public Institute of National Importance and SRM IST is a private university.
